content.title: Utah State and Villanova Will Play on Friday, March 20, at 2:10 p.m. MT on TNT - Utah State University Athletics
content.text: Skip To Main Content Pause All Rotators Skip Ad Close Ad Share: LOGAN, Utah – Utah State men's basketball NCAA Tournament first round game against Villanova on Saturday, March 20, will begin at 2:20 p.m. (MT) in San Diego, California, at Viejas Arena. The game will be televised nationally on TNT. USU is the ninth seed in the West Region and Villanova is the eighth seed. The winner of the Utah State-Villanova game will play the winner of 1-seed Arizona and 16-seed LIU on Sunday, March 22. Fans should stay tuned to www.UtahStateAggies.com as well as its social media platforms at @USUBasketball for complete NCAA Tournament information.
